plain_english_policy: This bill (HB359) is a targeted legislative change that expands parental rights in Alabama’s vital statistics system for stillborn births while maintaining strict confidentiality around abortion data. It does not directly regulate abortion but creates symbolic and procedural protections for parents grieving stillbirths.

evidence_quotes: When a fetal death occurs... the mother or father of the stillborn child may request the State Registrar to prepare a Certificate of Birth Resulting in Stillbirth within 30 days of the occurrence.

The Certificate of Birth Resulting in Stillbirth shall meet all of the filing requirements for a certificate for a live birth except the certificate need not contain any reference to the stillborn child's name if the parents... do not wish to provide a name for the stillborn child.
